BiblicalUsage: Rakal is a place in Palestine, a town in the south of Judah. David sent of the spoil to them in Rachal, and to them in the cities of the Jerahmeelites, and to them in the cities of the Kenites, after he recovered all that the Amalekites had carried away.
TheologicalSignificance: The point for me is that the spoil list is a thank-you note: David remembered the towns that had stood with him, and he sent them their share.
